data.prompt: Insert a small debugging snippet into your `upper_bound` function that records the size of the search interval (`hi - lo`) at the start of each loop iteration (e.g., `print('size', hi - lo)`). Run the function on a simple input such as `a=[1]` and `t=0` and observe the printed sizes.
